hero.alt: Stroll Head of the Harbor brand panel with the September 2026 cover

intro.text: Stroll Head of the Harbor is a monthly neighborhood magazine mailed to residents in Saint James and the Head of the Harbor area. Publisher Jae Hartzell fills each issue with resident spotlights, local business features and community happenings, because genuine connections with the neighbors next door and the business owners down the street make for a more meaningful place to live. Stroll is owned by The N2 Company and is not affiliated with any club, developer or homeowners association.

gallery.alt: September 2026 cover of Stroll Head of the Harbor featuring resident Vinny Galiano and Chef Roger

services.d: Neighbors, families, kids and pets featured right on the pages, and sometimes on the cover.
Stories on the business owners down the street, from restaurants to service pros.
Local businesses that support the magazine reach residents in their mailboxes each month.

reviews.text: Neighbors and advertising partners, a quick review helps others find Stroll Head of the Harbor.
